issues:
Some

elements containing isolated digits (small counters/labels) show getComputedStyle.fontFamily = 'Hanken Grotesk, sans-serif' WITHOUT 'CondNum' in the stack — those digits will NOT receive the condensed substitution. unicode-range only triggers when CondNum is present in the element's font stack. Main numeric surfaces (currency cards, ERP cells, time/date) DO include CondNum and render correctly. Recommend: ensure any component-level font-family override (Tailwind utility or inline) prepends 'CondNum' to keep digit substitution consistent app-wide. Currently affects a few small label

tags only — not the main financial UI.

action_items: Optional polish: audit components that override font-family (e.g., utility classes in Tailwind config like 'font-sans') to ensure 'CondNum' is included first in the font stack so unicode-range digit substitution applies universally. Could also add a global utility class for any element that explicitly sets font-family.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py register endpoint correctly hard-fails with 403 and short-circuits before any DB write — no risk of orphan users. Good.

App.js catch-all '*' -> Navigate '/' will infinite-redirect users to /login if not authenticated because ProtectedRoute will bounce them, but the bounce target is /login which DOES exist — so the loop terminates. Correct behavior; consider adding a friendly 404 page in the future.

calc.js margem 'por dentro' uses divisor (1-m); when user enters m>=100 (e.g., 150), m<1 check returns valor_unidade=0 silently. Consider clamping margem to [0,99.99] in the input layer to prevent UX confusion (zero unit price suddenly).

Login.jsx: no 'esqueci minha senha' flow exists now that public flows are gone — since password reset isn't yet exposed, users locked out depend on admin direct DB intervention. Recommend adding /api/auth/forgot-password (email-based) or an admin-create-user UI in Settings as a follow-up.
index.css: CondNum is hosted on Google Fonts as direct .woff2 URLs (not via @import) — if Google CDN is blocked, digits fall back to Hanken Grotesk silently. Acceptable but document this dependency.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data; used existing bid 6a1c5c9fe2f2b24398f3873e and toggled valor_compra/icms/margem/valor_venda on first row. After ICMS por fora test, the row was left with valor_compra=1000 + icms=10 + margem=10 (intermediate state during test). Auto-save persisted these values via PUT /api/bids/{id}/budget. If desired baseline (valor_compra=100, all others 0) is preferred, main agent can reset.
